now.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.
now.text: In episode 44, Director Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret and makes peace with the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'

proposed.text: In episode 42, Director Coulson rebuilds S.H.I.E.L.D. in secret and makes peace with the rival 'real S.H.I.E.L.D.'

changes.evidence: The record's last event, the truce with the rival S.H.I.E.L.D., happens in season 2 episode 20 'Scars' (episode 42 overall): the board agrees to merge the factions with Coulson remaining director. Episode 44 (season 2 finale) is the battle with Jiaying's Inhumans, which the record does not describe.
